purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
summary: Official Dongying Natural Resources and Planning Bureau evidence establishes a local real-estate registration/cadastral custodian and links a municipal map application. No anonymous, city-bounded parcel ID plus geometry response was verified. This is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
queryOutcomes: English and Chinese first-party discovery queries are recorded in city-10104-dongying.json. They located the official bureau, its real-estate registration section, and a bureau-linked map application, but no verified open parcel endpoint.
requestOutcomes: The official bureau homepage and registration section returned HTTP 200. The linked map application request timed out after 20 seconds. No login, credential, private token, unsafe field request, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [37.4464106417529, 118.51195574618] was preserved; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
No city boundary or complete Dongying coverage was established for an open geometry service.
No parcel geometry, native parcel identity, schema, or CRS was retrieved; no GeoJSON sample was retained.
The official bureau and map link establish local custody but do not qualify a runtime adapter or public parcel API.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, registration-detail, or personal fields were requested or retained.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only, if independently confirmed
source layer and public service metadata
excludedFields: tax/account/registration details beyond a safe native parcel ID
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; no synthetic identity was created. A future sample must contain exactly one stable native identity in GeoJSON properties, with source field mapping documented here.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
uncertainty: Local registry responsibility is evidenced, but anonymous viewer/API access, city scope, schema, CRS, native identity, and parcel geometry remain unknown. The map timeout is an access failure only and not evidence of citywide absence.
